name: Tk window
description: A window on this computer that shows the page, for interactive debugging. Needs tkinter, which not every system has (a headless device does not).

properties.name: width
properties.title: Width
properties.description: The width of the window's picture, in pixels (what a panel's width would be).

properties.name: height
properties.title: Height
properties.description: The height of the window's picture, in pixels (what a panel's height would be).

properties.name: inks
properties.title: Ink Set
properties.description: The inks of the panel this display stands in for, so pages are drawn and shown as that panel would show them: black and white, with red, with yellow or with both, six colors (Spectra 6) or seven (ACeP).
